description: 1996 is the Year of the Fire Rat in the Chinese zodiac, from February 19, 1996 to February 6, 1997. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1996 is the Year of the Fire Rat, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 19, 1996 and ended on February 6, 1997, so people born in 1996 before Feb 19 belong to the Wood Pig year.

sections.heading: 1996 Lunar New Year: start and end dates
paragraphs: Lunar New Year opened the Fire Rat year on February 19, 1996, and the year ran to February 6, 1997. So a birth date of Feb 19, 1996 or later counts as Fire Rat, and so do early 1997 birthdays through Feb 6; births in 1996 before Feb 19 still belong to the Wood Pig. That moving boundary comes from the lunisolar calendar, in which the new year starts with the second new moon after the winter solstice in most years, so its Gregorian date shifts by up to a month from one year to the next. Look sixty years either side and the pairing repeats: 1936 are Fire Rat years too. That Monday new year arrived with the Sun in Pisces in the Western zodiac.

sections.heading: What the Fire Rat is like
paragraphs: In a Fire Rat year, the Rat's shrewd calculation meets passionate urgency. Classical readings describe those born now as bold, persuasive and willing to take a public stand, while Water underneath keeps their timing sharp. They are rarely bored or boring. Their growth usually lies in letting caution and impulse cooperate, and in staying with worthwhile projects after the first thrill fades.

Belonging to the south and to the height of summer, Fire brings brightness, drive and visibility to any sign it colours. Classical texts connect it with enthusiasm, leadership and the urge to be seen and to make an impression. A Fire stem tends to make an animal more expressive, more daring and more openly emotional than its usual reputation suggests. People born in Fire years are often described as inspiring company and natural motivators. The caution most readings attach is a short fuse and a difficulty with slow seasons, when steady effort matters more than spark and the reward is a long way off.

sections.heading: 1996 in the animal cycle and in numerology
paragraphs: In numerology the year reduces to 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner work, giving a 7 year a quieter, more searching character. The digits of 1996 add up to 25, which reduces to 7. The Rat holds the first place among the twelve animals and its fixed element is Water. Set beside the year's Fire stem, water controls Fire, which readings use to describe how settled or stretched the combination feels. The year before was the Wood Pig and the year after is the Fire Ox.

Chinese almanacs name 1996 Bing-Zi, pairing the Fire stem Bing with the branch Zi. Both are Yang, as stem and branch always share a polarity, so of the hundred and twenty possible pairings only sixty ever occur, and each one names a single year in every cycle.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1996?
faq.answer: 1996 is the Year of the Fire Rat. It started on February 19, 1996 and ended on February 6, 1997.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1996?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 19. Born before February 19, 1996, you are a Wood Pig; born on or after it, you are a Fire Rat.

faq.question: What element is 1996 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Fire, a Yang year. The Rat's own fixed element is Water; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1996?
faq.answer: Bing-Zi. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Fire Rat year?
faq.answer: 2056, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1936.
